entities.summary: Leyla Alasgar gizi Mammadbeyova, née Zeynalova, was the first Azerbaijani female aviator. She is considered as the first female Muslim pilot and parachutist. She also was the first female pilot of Transcaucasia, of Southern Europe and of Southwest Asia.
